Every same-concept hot bearing result (lube/hot_before, motors r_heat_bearing, gearbox r_heat_bearing) tags them contributing with the bearing primary. A differential over viscosity, journal clearance, load and contamination, of which only some causes are oil condition. Its family siblings sj_vibe1 and sj_metal keep the bearing primary and lube contributing. Lube is primary where a lubricant fault is diagnosed: sj_no_oil, r_heat_oil, bf_smear.

Oil is one of three causes in a multi-cause label, 'oil, wear, or pressure'. Comparable results keep lube contributing (sj_heat_with_oil, r_chain_tension, r_thermo); it is primary only when the lubricant is the whole subject (wrong_lube_type, r_oilcond). The wet clutch is what fails, so brake stays primary.

The label 'positioner or air' names a differential, and the positioner is a valve component. Air supply is two of five checks. Contributing already lists it for pneumatics as a check to rule in or out. r_pneu_act differs because the pneumatic actuator or air supply is the diagnosis there.
